description: The line plot, titled “BBQ,” illustrates the accuracy of four different models—Squared Exponential, T5ith, ELU, and LLaMA-2-chat-7B—as a function of the number of demonstrations, ranging from 0 to 1500 along the linear x-axis labeled “#Demonstrations.” The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy,” spans from 45 to 55 and is also linearly scaled, with major tick marks at intervals of 5. The “Squared Exponential” model (dark blue solid line with circular markers) starts at approximately 53.5 accuracy at 0 demonstrations, rises to about 55.5 by 250 demonstrations, and remains flat near 55.5 through 1500 demonstrations. The “T5ith” model (medium blue solid line with circular markers) begins at roughly 49.5, dips slightly to 49.2 around 250, then gradually increases to 50.5 by 1500. The “ELU” model (light blue solid line with circular markers) starts at 46.5, rises modestly to 47.5 by 1500. The “LLaMA-2-chat-7B” model (pink dashed line with circular markers) remains nearly flat at approximately 45.5 across all demonstration counts. A gray rectangular bar is positioned along the x-axis near 0, likely indicating a baseline or control region. The legend in the upper right identifies each model’s corresponding line style and color.
